title: UNICAL 2026/27 Admission, Post-UTME, Supplementary Screening and Student Fees
summary: The University of Calabar's 2026/27 ordinary Post-UTME and Direct Entry registration has closed, although its official portal currently advertises supplementary applications for specified undersubscribed programmes. The advertised ₦2,000 UTME screening fee is distinct from school tuition, acceptance fees and clearance.
feeNote: The 2026/27 University of Calabar notice specifies a ₦2,000 non-refundable Post-UTME fee, which does not cover admission acceptance, tuition, accommodation or clearance. The DE page separately mentions a ₦3,500 receipt but currently reports applications closed. No current university-wide programme-level tuition sum was established by the checked official notices.
timeline: The original UTME window ran from 1 June to the published 31 July deadline. On 12 October 2026, separate ordinary UTME and DE entry pages say closed; a limited supplementary invitation is shown on the official landing page without a universal closing date.
requirements: 2026 JAMB registration number and UTME score of at least 150 for the route specified in the university's screening announcement; individual programme rules still apply.
WAEC, NECO or NABTEB O-level credit subjects that match the course, correctly recorded on JAMB and the university's system.
An active personal email address and phone number, and a recent passport photograph when requested in the application.

For supplementary applications, eligibility for one of the specifically advertised undersubscribed programmes; Medicine and Surgery requires O-level credits at one sitting for the referenced exercise.
steps: Open the university's 2026/27 official Post-UTME portal and check whether the particular ordinary UTME, DE or supplementary route is accepting applications.
If the listed supplementary programme is eligible for your JAMB result and choice-of-institution record, select the correct advertised course and confirm the university's stated admission conditions.
Enter your genuine JAMB registration number on the official portal's verification form and check the returned biodata and O-level requirements.
During an authorised open registration window, supply accurate grades and contact details, pay the university-generated screening charge, then print the acknowledgement or registration slip.
Check an actual admission outcome on the University of Calabar and JAMB CAPS platforms; registration and screening receipts alone are not admission offers.
After a university admission offer, follow newly issued student clearance instructions and pay acceptance, university fees and housing charges separately only on an official university invoice.
notes: The 2026/27 portal's supplementary invitation is limited to advertised courses; the ordinary Post-UTME and DE application pages currently show closed.
UNICAL's general 2026 admission notice allows candidates seeking change to the university who meet the stated minimum, subject to JAMB processing and university programme eligibility.
Medicine and Surgery candidates are required to meet the university's one-sitting O-level rule in its 2026/27 announcement.
Do not interpret the screening amount as annual tuition or an admission guarantee.
The university's fee and clearance requirements must be checked for the specific 2026/27 faculty and admitted-student cohort before payment.

title: Federal University Lokoja 2026/27 Admissions, CAPS, Fees and Freshers' Registration
summary: Federal University Lokoja's 2026/27 Post-UTME screening closed on 13 September after a ₦2,000 Remita screening charge. Its official university calendar schedules new-student registration to start 26 October 2026 and resumption for 2 November; students must still obtain a valid CAPS offer and university-specific payment instructions.
feeNote: The university's ₦2,000 Remita fee is a screening charge, not the school fee, acceptance fee, accommodation payment or clearance invoice. A current uniform 2026/27 undergraduate tuition rate was not verified. Pay only what the official student registration portal invoices for the particular programme and session.
timeline: Screening deadline: 13 September 2026. Official admissions calendar lists forwarding of recommendations to JAMB CAPS 5 October, new-student registration from 26 October and first-year resumption 2 November 2026, subject to revision.
requirements: A 2026 UTME score of at least 160 and first-choice Federal University Lokoja selection on JAMB, or valid JAMB Direct Entry status where applicable.
Candidate aged 16 or older by 30 September 2026 under the university's screening circular.
At least five qualifying O-level credits including English, with one-sitting requirements for Nursing, Medical Laboratory Science, Law and Pharmaceutical Science.
O-level results uploaded to JAMB e-Facility at a JAMB office or accredited CBT centre and corresponding original certificates for later admission verification.
steps: Visit FUL's published 2026/27 Post-UTME notice and check the university's latest calendar; the screening deadline of 13 September has already passed.
Open the official FUL Post-UTME portal with the genuine JAMB registration number to inspect any previously submitted screening and candidate information.

During a future university-authorised screening period, generate an official Remita Retrieval Reference inside the FUL admission portal, pay the stated screening charge and upload the programme's required O-level subjects.
Check the admission offer through JAMB CAPS and the university; accept the actual JAMB offer and print your JAMB admission letter only if admitted.
From the university's scheduled 26 October new-student portal opening, follow updated FUL instructions for acceptance, biodata, clearance documentation and an official student fee invoice.
Save university invoices and receipts, complete the faculty verification and course-registration instructions, and monitor any official revision to the planned 2 November resumption date.
notes: The university states explicitly that a successful Post-UTME screening exercise does not guarantee admission.
The university's 26 October registration-opening and 2 November resumption dates were still future scheduled dates on 12 October; portal availability does not prove registration has begun.
Some listed professional programmes require O-level credits in a single sitting rather than the standard two-sitting rule.
JAMB e-Facility O-level uploads should use an accredited JAMB CBT centre or a JAMB office, not an unapproved cybercafé.
Do not infer the university's actual acceptance, school or hostel charges from the ₦2,000 admission screening fee.
